steps.SIM_SRC_NO_NETWORK: The source has no network interface with an address or a cable.
steps.SIM_DST_NO_NETWORK: The target has no network interface with an address or a cable.
steps.SIM_LOCAL: Same host — the traffic never leaves the machine.
steps.SIM_L2_TO_TARGET: Delivered to the target over VLAN {segment}.
steps.SIM_L2_NO_PATH: No cable path carries VLAN {segment} to the next hop.
steps.SIM_L2_OTHER_SEGMENT: The next hop is on another VLAN than {segment}.
steps.SIM_L3_NO_SUBNET: The source address belongs to no subnet in the project.
steps.SIM_L3_NO_GATEWAY: Subnet {subnet} has no gateway on any device.
steps.SIM_L3_NEXT_HOP_UNSUPPORTED: {router} forwards via {via}; routing over several routers is not simulated yet.
steps.SIM_FW_DEFAULT_ALLOW: No rule matches; {router} allows by default.
steps.SIM_FW_DEFAULT_DENY: No rule matches; {router} denies by default ({from} → {to}).
steps.SIM_FW_INTRA_ZONE_DENY: Inside zone {from} — traffic between subnets is denied.
steps.SIM_NAT_MISSING: No masquerade (source NAT) on {router} {interface} for this zone.
steps.SIM_WAN_NO_UPLINK: {interface} is not connected to the Internet.
steps.SIM_DOCKER_NAT: Docker network {network} — NAT through the host.
steps.SIM_DOCKER_INTERNAL: Docker network {network} is internal — no traffic leaves it.
